cardOverview.overviewText: A Times Titanium variant designed for frequent moviegoers, offering ticket discounts, lifestyle vouchers, and dining perks.

items.child: 25% off on movie tickets via BookMyShow.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 25% off on movie tickets via BookMyShow.
benefitRows.offer: 25% off on movie tickets via BookMyShow (A cardholder can purchase a maximum of 4 discounted tickets per card per month.|A maximum discount of Rs 350 can be availed per transaction by cardholder.|A discount of Rs 50 on Food and Beverage to be availed only once by the user.)
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Upto a maximum of 10% discount of your bill when you use your HDFC Bank Times Card Credit via PayEazy on EazyDiner.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the EazyDiner app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy 10% instant discount up to ₹1,500 on your bill. Complete the payment using your HDFC Times Titanium credit card to unlock the offer.
